description.p: A Linux-native configurator for MOZA force-feedback flight bases. MOZA ships no Linux tooling, and its Windows application does not run usefully under Wine, so configuring a base has meant keeping a Windows install around. tux-ffb talks to the base directly.

ul.li: Axis response curves, deadzone, input saturation and invert
Spring, damper, friction and inertia, globally and per axis
Adaptive centring, force-feedback mode and grip decode mode
Cogging torque calibration, run from Linux
Named profiles, saved as plain YAML

description.p: Tested against the AB9. The AB6 is expected to work but has not been verified on hardware.
